docsConsulted: https://base-ui.com/llms.txt (absent — internal, not a documented component)

keyProps.CompositeRoot.props: Array<Record | (() => Record)> — extra prop sets spread on the element
keyProps.CompositeRoot.tag / refs: default tag (div); refs: Ref<HTMLElement|null>[] to merge
keyProps.CompositeRoot.loopFocus / onLoop: wrap at the ends / custom wrap target (event, prevIndex, nextIndex, elementsRef) => number
keyProps.CompositeRoot.highlightedIndex / onHighl: controlled highlight index (the controlled pair for composites)
keyProps.CompositeRoot.enableHomeAndEndKeys: boolean, @default false — Home/End jump to first/last (Tabs.List hard-enables it)
keyProps.CompositeRoot.disabledIndices / modifier: number[] of indices treated disabled while still focusable; ModifierKey[] (@default []) that allow normal actions
keyProps.CompositeRoot.highlightItemOnHover / onM: misc: hover highlight, element-map callback, key handler, root ref
keyProps.CompositeList.children / elementsRef / l: elementsRef = DOM-ordered element list (explicit indexes may leave holes); labelsRef = parallel label list intended for typeahead; onMapChange publishes index metadata
keyProps.useCompositeListItem: params { guess?: boolean (@default false, guesses initial index from render order to avoid a post-mount re-render for flat lists), index?, label?, metadata?, textRef? } -> { ref, index }
keyProps.useCompositeRoot: params { orientation, grid, loopFocus, onLoop, highlightedIndex, onHighlightedIndexChange, direction (required), rootRef, enableHomeAndEndKeys, stopEventPropagation, disabledIndices, modifierKeys } -> { props, highlightedIndex, onHighlightedIndexChange(index, shouldScrollIntoView?), elementsRef, onMapChange, relayKeyboardEvent }

dataAttributes: None intrinsic — composites emit whatever state/stateAttributesMapping produces; consumers (Tabs, Menu, Select, Combobox) layer their own data-* on top.
gridNavigation: gridNavigation(config: { cols: number, dense?: boolean, itemSizes?: {width,height}[] }) => CompositeGridNavigator(state: { event, elementsRef, highlightedIndex, minIndex, maxIndex, orientation, loopFocus, onLoop, disabledIndices, rtl }) => number. Opt-in (composites that omit `grid` never reference it, so bundlers tree-shake it). Closest thing in 1.8.0 to grid/data-grid navigation — an internal hook, not a component.
renderProp: CompositeRoot/CompositeItem accept render/className/style via BaseUIComponentProps; useCompositeRoot returns raw props to spread yourself.

controlled.uncontrolled: none — composites are index-registration based; the consumer owns the index

keyboard: Arrow keys move highlight/focus along the orientation axis (2D when `grid` is passed), wrapping if loopFocus; Home/End only when enableHomeAndEndKeys; disabledIndices skipped; modifierKeys preserve native behaviour; stopEventPropagation optionally swallows navigation keys. Typeahead is NOT provided: CompositeList exposes labelsRef; the only typeahead reference in the package is a doc comment in CompositeList.d.ts naming React Aria's `useTypeahead`. Consumers must implement typeahead.
notableDifferences: React Aria models collections declaratively (react-stately Collection/CollectionBuilder/ListState + <Item>/<Section> or `items`); Base UI composites register DOM order at runtime (CompositeList + useCompositeListItem) with an index-based highlight model. No public Collection/Item/Section and no useListData-style store.
React Aria exposes useListNavigation/useTypeahead/useSelectableCollection publicly; Base UI exports only the internals above, and typeahead is absent.

Migration consequence for repo widgets built on RAC collections (table.tsx uses Collection/useTableOptions; tag-select.tsx uses ListData/useListData; tags.tsx uses TagGroup/TagList): keep React Aria, or re-express on a component that already owns its collection — Base UI 1.8.0 Combobox added component-level `createItems`, `useFilter`, `useFilteredItems` (combobox/index.parts.d.ts) rather than internals/composite.
